integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained after the published equivalent formulation of the constant; the sharpness witness is exact. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: No equality-case classification is claimed; the theorem is only the sharp universal bound. The direct defining paper is from 2023, while the recorded first public date is the earliest exact public date among the supporting literature sources used here.
title: Sharp universal bound for the isosceles Dunkl–Williams constant
